answer: Stop sybils with an oasis wander fable: an agent stakes a bond for one oasis well. Each cycle it wanders to the well and files a fable, a stop log; verifiers check the stamps, voiding a well whose fable is copied, out of order, or claimed twice, slashing the bond. Forging 1,000 needs 1,000 wells at 18x each: each fable fits one oasis well and one wander, and cannot be copied, shared, or bulk-bought. Honest agents wander and keep oasis rights.
